name: Sienna
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, she features deep espresso roots that blend into a rich chocolate brunette. Warm ribbons of toasted caramel run through the mid-lengths, with deeper brown woven between them for dimension. Her brightest pieces are the honey blonde highlights framing both sides of the face, creating a defined contrast against the darker roots.

All photos are taken in natural lighting. She arrives professionally colored and styled. Care for her as you would your natural hair, and touch her up after unboxing if needed.

All sales are final
